navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the Bay of Palma, Mallorca's coast, the marina cluster (Port Adriano/Portals) and the Mallorca↔Menorca leg (~45 nm).
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) runs the longer Balearic trunks — Mallorca↔Ibiza (~75 nm) and Mallorca↔mainland.

precedents.why_it_matters: Mallorca pairs a huge premium charter base with a real inter-island commuter network.

regulatory_note: Spanish flag / EU; Spanish maritime authority (DGMM); Balearic port authority (Autoritat Portuària de Balears); Palma's matriculation-tax and charter-licence regime is a known charter consideration.
seasonality: Summer-peaked (May–Oct) but Palma's year-round charter/refit industry gives a non-seasonal commercial base.
summary: Palma de Mallorca is the Mediterranean's largest charter and superyacht refit base (Port Adriano, Puerto Portals, STP shipyard), and Mallorca anchors the Balearic inter-island network to Menorca, Ibiza and Formentera. Short coastal hops and the Mallorca↔Menorca leg sit inside Pioneer II range, while the Mallorca↔Ibiza trunk is a Quanta-LR line-haul. A vast HNW base and dense ferry market (Baleària, Trasmediterránea) support both premium and commuter tiers.
tagline: The largest charter and superyacht base in the Mediterranean, anchoring the Balearic inter-island market.
